title: The community project garden got more playable
summary:
A community-directory day: new games and learning tools joined the showcase, and the links were persuaded to keep working.

The Games showcase now includes AIStorium and AI Word Search, giving visitors two more examples of people building odd, useful, and pleasantly unnecessary things with Pollinations.

Prompt Explorer was added to the Learn category, while the OpenWebUI tutorial link was updated so the path from curiosity to working example has fewer dead ends.

Project listings were refreshed, broken links restored, and build issues resolved. The directory continues its difficult work of being a directory that points somewhere.
